statement: Let G=(V,E) be finite, d>=1, F a field, K a subspace of F^I with blocks I_v satisfying (R),(L),(E) of PNP-001-PAPER-BASIS-BLOWUP-v4.0 Sec.4, and B a finite spanning family of K. Then tw(H_B) >= d(tw(G)+1)-1, where H_B is the support-overlap graph of B.
derivation: Thm 4.1 gives an injection iota: V x [d] -> J mapping every edge of G[K_d] to an edge of H_B, so G[K_d] is a subgraph of H_B (non-edges need not be preserved). tw is subgraph-monotone (paper Sec.2). Lemma 2.2 gives tw(G[K_d]) = d(tw(G)+1)-1. Hence tw(H_B) >= d(tw(G)+1)-1. Consequence: if clauses 1-3 of Candidate A hold, then F(m,s,S_A,U_A) >= d(tw(G_{m,s})+1)-1; clause 4 is the negation of this and is dropped.

Thm 1.3: if A in PH and search-MCSP^A[s] has no poly(s)-space, poly(s)-update streaming algorithm, then P != NP; its proof applies P=NP to the Sigma3SAT oracle calls of Thm 1.2. Consequence for (b): MMW supplies an admissible A (any A in PH), but NOT an unconditional oracle-free poly(s)-space poly(s)-update one-pass algorithm. Removing the Sigma3SAT oracle is exactly what P=NP would supply, so (b) is unsupported as stated. The contradiction is of QE* shape (conditional on a P=NP-type hypothesis), not a refutation of Candidate A. proved_step: Lemma R: if K ⊆ F^I with blocks satisfies (R),(L),(E) with parameter d>=1 and B is a finite spanning family of K, then tw(H_B) >= d(tw(G)+1)-1. Proof: Thm 4.1 injection ι: V×[d] -> J maps E(G[K_d]) into E(H_B); pulling back a tree decomposition of H_B along ι gives one of G[K_d] of no greater width; Lemma 2.2 gives tw(G[K_d]) = d(tw G+1)-1. Consequence: clauses 1-2 of Candidate A force F >= d(tw(G)+1)-1, so clauses 1-4 are jointly unsatisfiable for large parameters.
